text.en:
Section sixty-two of Commonwealth Act Numbered Fifty seven, entitled An Act establishing a
form of government for the City of Iloilo as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred
fifty-eight, is further amended to read as follows:
"Section 62. Persons arrested to be promptly brought before Court. - Preliminary examinations in Municipal
Court and Court of First Instance, Every person arrested shall, without unnecessary delay, be brought before
the Municipal Court, or Court of First Instance for preliminary hearing, release on bail, or trial. In cases
triable.in the Municipal Court the defendant shall not be entitled as of right to preliminary examination, except
a summary one to enable the court to fix the bail. In cases triable only in the Court of First Instance the
defendant shall not be entitled as of right to. a preliminary examination in any.case where the city fiscal, after
a due investigation of the facts, shall have presented an information against him in proper form. In
both,instances, the city fiscal shall have the information filed under oath to be sworn to by him before the
corresponding judge without the necessity of being accompanied: by affidavits of witnesses. Bit the Court of
First Instance may make such summary investigation into the case as it may deem.necessary to enable it to fix
the bail or to determine whether the offense is bailable:"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 31, 1939.
